postState.name: TPO Prior-Value Momentum
postState.description: Routes on a curated twelve-signal momentum scorecard whose per-signal scores were read live at 1h before the gate was set. Eleven advisory prior-session TPO conditions, ordered rarest-first so no row masks another, tell the model where price sits against yesterday value area. TPO feeds no signal module and cannot score; it shapes what the agent reads, not what the router computes.
postState.tagline: Curated momentum scorecard at a 0.65 floor; prior TPO value shapes the read.

reviewContext.intentSummary: Turn the TPO read from advice into a gate. Add one required, verdict-null condition, TPO_HAS_DIRECTION, true when developing value has migrated clear of the prior value area or the developing point of control has moved at least 0.25 percent off the prior one. When TPO has no opinion - value flat, or the developing profile absent in the first UTC hour - the required gate blocks compose-trade before any LLM call. The verdict ladder is unchanged and still supplies direction. Only the conditions axis is sent.
assumptions: Measured 2026-09-11: get_agent_coin_qualification carries a requiredConditions gate (requiredCount, evaluatedCount, trueCount, failedKeys) beside the aggregate gate, reading NOT_ENFORCED because no condition in the account set required:true. This is the first.

The gate is direction-neutral on purpose: the required gate ANDs every required condition, so a directional required condition would have to be true for both sides at once. Whether the platform also enforces trade-side against the verdict is UNMEASURED and is read after apply from the per-coin long/short fields.

Measured 2026-09-11 on contract 54.1.0: a null column value reads FALSE, not UNRESOLVED (EMA5_13 '-' -> FALSE on 8 of 8, UNRESOLVED 0). So in the first UTC hour, with every tpo* absent, all four members read FALSE and the gate blocks. Intended.

Measured 2026-09-11 over 36 CRYPTO instruments: the four members fire on roughly 31 of 36 during normal hours; VALUE_UNCHANGED_IN_BALANCE held the other 5. So the gate is mild by construction - it removes flat-profile setups, not most setups.
Measured 2026-09-11: UPDATE merges. Only conditions is sent; signal rules, gate, entry and the report section are preserved by omission.
Scope: revision only. No binding change, no deployment, no fund allocation. PVM Alpha holds no Radar assignment; deployment is the user's manual step.
serverAssumptions: Rendered market values are a point-in-time preview and are not mutation authority.

section.title: TPO value migration
section.text:
Positive spread means the first metric sits above the second. pTpoVAH: the upper edge of the previous completed UTC session's 70% value area. pTpoVAH_close_spread: % gap pTpoVAH vs close. pTpoVAL: the lower edge of the previous completed UTC session's 70% value area. pTpoVAL_close_spread: % gap pTpoVAL vs close. pTpoPOC: the price bin that held the most time in the previous completed UTC session. pTpoPOC_close_spread: % gap pTpoPOC vs close. pTpoVAH_pTpoVAL_spread: % gap pTpoVAH vs pTpoVAL. pTpoVAL_open_spread: % gap pTpoVAL vs open. tpoPOC: the price bin holding the most time in the current UTC session, over 5-bps bins — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the session's first 60 minutes. tpoPOC_pTpoVAH_spread: % gap tpoPOC vs pTpoVAH. tpoPOC_pTpoVAL_spread: % gap tpoPOC vs pTpoVAL. tpoPOC_pTpoPOC_spread: % gap tpoPOC vs pTpoPOC. close: the bar's close price. close_tpoPOC_spread: % gap close vs tpoPOC. tpoVAH: the upper edge of the 70% value area around the current session's point of control — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the session's first 60 minutes. tpoVAH_tpoVAL_spread: % gap tpoVAH vs tpoVAL. tpoShape: where the point of control sits inside the current session's value area, p-shape at or above 0.67 of its span and b-shape at or below the mirror — a point-in-time read at its own fold (p-shape / b-shape / balanced).
